question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'little'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **synonym** of the word** 'little'** is **small or minute**.
 
• The given sentence with blank number (1) talks about **Shakespeare's life**, of which many parts are unknown to the world and** little or minute **biography is available about him.
 
• So, the **appropriate word** suilable for the given blank is **'little'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is:** **little.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** The meanings of other words in the options are:
